rawText:
SQUIDWEAVE - The Autonomous Marketing Brain for B2B Growth

THE PROBLEM:
B2B marketing is broken. Fragmented tools, manual workflows, and zero intelligence burn $120B annually with diminishing returns.
- Tool Fragmentation: Marketers juggle 10+ disconnected apps for outreach, analytics, CRM, and content — no single source of truth.
- No Intelligence Layer: Campaigns run on gut feeling, not data. Past learnings are lost. Every campaign starts from scratch.
- Skyrocketing Costs: Enterprise stacks cost $800-2K per seat monthly. Mid-market companies are priced out or underserved.

THE SOLUTION:
One brain that does it all. Scrapes, decides, remembers, and executes — at zero per-seat cost.
- Multi-Agent Orchestration: Autonomous agents discover conversations across Reddit, Twitter/X, and the web — then analyze, rank, and act on opportunities without human intervention.
- AI Decision Engine: Scores tactics per campaign context and picks the optimal outreach strategy. No guesswork — every decision is data-driven.
- Learning Memory: Compounds campaign outcomes into trusted playbooks. Performance improves with every execution — the brain gets smarter over time.

THE SQUIDWEAVE LOOP:
1. CONNECT — Scrape Reddit, Twitter/X, Google, company sites
2. DECIDE — Score tactics, pick optimal strategy per campaign
3. EXECUTE — Generate localized outreach, send via SMTP
4. LEARN — Consolidate outcomes into playbooks & memory
5. REPEAT — Smarter every cycle

KEY CAPABILITIES:
- Multi-Platform Scraping: Reddit, Twitter/X, Google search, company websites — extract leads, conversations, and intent signals.
- AI Decision Engine: Scores tactics per campaign context and selects the optimal outreach strategy automatically.
- Episodic Memory: Consolidates outcomes into targetProfiles, tacticObservations, and trusted playbooks over time.
- Zero-Cost Automation: SMTP delivery, free email enrichment, Cal.com scheduling — no per-seat SaaS subscriptions required.
- Localization Engine: Generates locale-aware content packs via LM Studio with deterministic fallback for any market.
- Safety-First Execution: DRY_RUN by default, execution receipts, live approval gates, and full audit trails for every action.

MARKET:
$8.3B global marketing automation market (2024), growing to $19.7B by 2032 at 12.3% CAGR. B2B segment growing at 14.1%.

TRACTION:
84+ production API endpoints. 6 core automation modules. 3 platform connectors live. Zero per-seat cost.
- Full automation engine with scheduler (120s ticks)
- AI decision scoring against real campaign summaries
- Episodic memory: targetProfiles, tacticObservations, playbooks
- Contact sourcing pipeline with dedup & enrichment
- Localized content generation via LM Studio
- GHL (GoHighLevel) bi-directional sync
- VC funding pipeline with investor scoring engine
- Zero-cost SMTP delivery + email enrichment
- Docker + Postgres deployment ready
- React UI (LocaleWeave) with auth guard
- CI/CD via GitHub Actions
- Desktop app (Electron) in development

COMPETITIVE EDGE:
- Learning Memory: Episodic playbooks (vs basic workflows in HubSpot, none in Clay/Apollo)
- Multi-Platform Scraping: Reddit, X, Web (vs limited in HubSpot, enrichment only in Clay)
- AI Decision Engine: Tactic scoring (vs A/B testing in HubSpot, sequences in Clay)
- Per-Seat Cost: Zero open core (vs $800-2K/mo HubSpot, $100-500/mo Clay)
- Data Sovereignty: Local-first (vs cloud-only competitors)

BUSINESS MODEL:
- Open Source Core: Free, self-hosted, 3 connectors, community support
- Enterprise: $500-2K/mo, managed cloud, CRM integrations, team collaboration
- Professional Services: Custom, implementation consulting, white-label, training
- Target revenue mix at $200K MRR: 60% Enterprise, 30% Services, 10% Open Core

THE ASK:
$750K seed round. 18-month runway to Series A.
Use of funds: 40% Engineering (2 senior hires), 30% Go-to-Market (community, content), 20% Infrastructure (cloud, ops), 10% Operations (legal, finance)

MILESTONES TO SERIES A:
- 1,000 active open-source installs
- 50+ paying enterprise customers generating $50K MRR
- Native Salesforce & HubSpot integrations shipped
- Series A Target: $3-5M at $15-25M valuation
